records.title: Trade Minister asks whether von Schorlemer can join demobilization work
records.header_literal: B) NKJ v LP (08.40 p.m., November 4th); FUER UKS 1400 (4). OBERLEUTNANT VON SCHORLEMER OBERKOMMANDO M VERWALTUNGSSTAB; RICHI-252
records.readable_german: Erbitte Rueckantwort durch Funkspruch, ob Sie zur Beschaeftigung im Handelsministerium, Demobilmachungsgruppe, abkoemmlich. Handelsminister.
records.meaning: The Trade Minister asks for a radio reply on whether the addressee can be released for work in the ministry demobilization group. The clear header names First Lieutenant von Schorlemer at the Oberkommando M administrative staff.
notes: The source contains 33 printed dashes, including six complete masked groups. They are part of the native 252-slot frame. Their supplied values are editorial source-mask fills, not recovered visible coordinates.
The five observed-coordinate substitutions are separately priced. They repair word-level corruptions; there is no source insertion or change of key.
The clear address is an independent source witness for the surname in the later p155 B response. The two bodies were enciphered under different published period keys.

records.title: Von Schorlemer cannot currently be released from the administrative staff
records.header_literal: B) LP v NKJ (7.09 p.m., November 7th); 0800 VON UKS (7/11); RICHI-160
records.readable_german: Handelsminister Berlin. Oblt. v. Schorlemer z. Zeit hier nicht abkoemmlich. OKM Verw. Stab.
records.meaning: The administrative staff informs the Trade Minister in Berlin that First Lieutenant von Schorlemer cannot currently be released.
notes: The source visibly prints four dashes. The 160-slot native frame is unchanged.
The name repair SCKORLEMER to SCHORLEMER is supported by the independent clear p122 B address, not by a guessed biography. No first name or unique historical person is supplied.
The exchange concerns availability for duty; it does not itself establish that a reassignment or recall actually occurred.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier unreviewed repository candidates are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All source slots are preserved in their native order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Witness completions are explicitly nonhistorical.
